instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot. In a cozy room by a window with books and roses, an older blonde woman (R1) in a beige shirt and pants sits on the left, leaning forward and talking to the bearded man (R2) in a beige shirt and pants sitting in an armchair on the right. They hold hands, with his hand clasping hers. Soft natural light from the window highlights their warm, intimate interaction in a neutral-toned setting.
